```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(VGAM)
library(pROC)
library(ResourceSelection)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
set.seed(123)
```

```{r define_functions}
source(file.path(here::here(),"R/utils/modeling_stats_utility_functions.R"))
```

```{r read_in_and_clean_cycle_data, include=F}
df <- readr::read_rds("data/clean_data/cld_filtered.rds") |> 
  dplyr::rename(pregnant = pregnant_bool)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age < 35 ~ "<35",
    age >= 35 & age <= 37 ~ "35-37",
    age >= 38 & age <= 40 ~ "38-40",
    age >= 41 ~ "41+"
  )) %>%
  mutate(amh_bin = case_when(
    amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
    amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
    amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
    amh > 3.0 ~ "High"
  ))

df$age_group <- as.factor(df$age_group)
df$amh_bin <- as.factor(df$amh_bin)

# Number of unique PAT ids
df = df |> dplyr::mutate(the_year = lubridate::year(treatment_start_date))
```

```{r define_payment_functions}
# Single Cycle Egg (Tiered)
payout_egg_single <- function(eggs) {
  ifelse(eggs <= 2, 0.5,
        ifelse(eggs <= 4, 0.25,
                0))
}

# Multi-Cycle Egg
payout_egg_multi <- function(total_eggs) {
  ifelse(total_eggs < 10, 0.5,
        ifelse(total_eggs < 15, 0.25,
        0))
}

# Euploid Embryo
payout_euploid <- function(has_euploid) {
  ifelse(has_euploid == 0, 1.0, 0)
}

# Live Birth
payout_livebirth <- function(live_birth) {
  ifelse(live_birth == 0, 1.0, 0)
}

# Make patient grid.
ages <- seq(30, 42, by = 2)
amh_values <- c(0.3, 0.8, 2.0, 4.0)

patient_grid <- expand.grid(
  age = ages,
  amh = amh_values
)
```

## Key Variables
```{r make_tbl_for_key_variables}
var_summary <- df %>%
  mutate(
    total_2pn_eggs = num_2pn_from_fresh_eggs + num_2pn_from_frozen_eggs
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cycles = n(),
    
    # Euploid embryos
    mean_euploid    = mean(num_euploid_blast, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_euploid_l   = quantile(num_euploid_blast, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_euploid_u   = quantile(num_euploid_blast, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_ge1_euploid = mean(coalesce(num_euploid_blast, 0) >= 1) * 100,
    
    # Eggs retrieved
    mean_eggs       = mean(num_eggs_collected, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_eggs_l      = quantile(num_eggs_collected, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_eggs_u      = quantile(num_eggs_collected, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # MII eggs
    mean_m2         = mean(num_m2_eggs, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_m2_l        = quantile(num_m2_eggs, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_m2_u        = quantile(num_m2_eggs, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Fertilized (2PN)
    mean_2pn        = mean(total_2pn_eggs, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_2pn_l       = quantile(total_2pn_eggs, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_2pn_u       = quantile(total_2pn_eggs, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # AMH
    mean_amh        = mean(amh, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_amh_l       = quantile(amh, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_amh_u       = quantile(amh, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # AFC
    mean_afc        = mean(afc, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_afc_l       = quantile(afc, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_afc_u       = quantile(afc, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


var_summary_fmt <- var_summary %>%
  mutate(
    eggs_fmt = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean_eggs, iqr_eggs_l, iqr_eggs_u),
    m2_fmt   = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean_m2, iqr_m2_l, iqr_m2_u),
    p2n_fmt  = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean_2pn, iqr_2pn_l, iqr_2pn_u),
    amh_fmt  = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", mean_amh, iqr_amh_l, iqr_amh_u),
    afc_fmt  = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean_afc, iqr_afc_l, iqr_afc_u),
    euploid_fmt = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", mean_euploid, iqr_euploid_l, iqr_euploid_u),
    euploid_pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_ge1_euploid)
  )

var_summary_fmt |> 
  knitr::kable()
```

# Patient-level Statistical Models {.tabset}

Note - models in this section include only treatments of type 'ICSI' (the majority of the treatments) and NOT those of type 'IVF'.

```{r}
m1df = df |> 
  dplyr::filter(treatment == 'ICSI')
```

This filter reduces the number of rows of data in this cycle-level table from `r nrow(df)` to `r nrow(m1df)`.

## Binomial Logistic Model {.tabset}

### Just by Age group

The model is this:

$pregant \sim age + afc + amhbin$

```{r}
# Clean data
m1df <- m1df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pregnant),
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(amh_bin),
    !is.na(afc)
  )

# Model
logit_model <- glm(
  pregnant ~ age + amh_bin + afc,
  family = binomial,
  data = m1df
)

validate_model(logit_model, data = m1df, outcome = "pregnant")

# Summary table
logit_summary <- summary(logit_model)$coefficients

knitr::kable(logit_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Attempt-Level Modeling

```{r}
df_attempt_recalc <- m1df %>%
  group_by(pat_id) %>%
  arrange(treatment_start_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(attempt_num = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

attempt_model <- glm(
  pregnant ~ age + afc + amh_bin + attempt_num,
  family = binomial,
  data = df_attempt_recalc
)

attempt_summary <- summary(attempt_model)$coefficients
kable(attempt_summary, digits = 3)
```

## Predicted Probability by Attempt

```{r}
age_seq <- seq(
  floor(min(df_attempt_recalc$age, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ceiling(max(df_attempt_recalc$age, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = 1
)

cycle_seq <- sort(unique(df_attempt_recalc$attempt_num))
cycle_seq <- cycle_seq[cycle_seq <= 3]

# Calculate predicted probabilities given AFC/AMH per unique combination of age/cycle to maintain in-group distribution
attempt_predictions <- df_attempt_recalc %>%
  filter(attempt_num %in% 1:3) %>%
  group_by(age, attempt_num) %>%
  summarise(
    afc = mean(afc, na.rm = TRUE),
    amh = mean(amh, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High"))
  )

attempt_predictions$predicted_p <- predict(
  attempt_model,
  newdata = attempt_predictions,
  type = "response"
)



attempt_predictions_kable <- attempt_predictions %>%
  mutate(
    age_display = case_when(
      age <= 30 ~ "<=30",
      age >= 44 ~ ">=44",
      TRUE ~ as.character(age)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_display, attempt_num) %>%
  summarise(
    afc = mean(afc, na.rm = TRUE),
    amh = mean(amh, na.rm = TRUE),
    predicted_p = mean(predicted_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High")),
    age_display = factor(age_display, levels = c("<=30", as.character(31:43), ">=44"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(age_display, attempt_num)

kable(attempt_predictions_kable, digits = 3)

# Plot cycle-level probabilities per age
ggplot(attempt_predictions, aes(x = age, y = predicted_p, color = factor(attempt_num))) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1, se = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("1" = "purple", "2" = "navy", "3" = "darkgreen"),
    name = "Cycle"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(22, 48),
    breaks = seq(22, 48, by = 2),
    minor_breaks = seq(22, 48, by = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    minor_breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probability of Pregnancy by Age and Cycle",
    subtitle = "Model-adjusted probabilities averaged over AFC and AMH distribution",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Probability of Pregnancy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

attempt_predictions %>%
  write_csv("outputs/attempt_probabilities_by_age_long.csv")

attempt_predictions_wide <- attempt_predictions_kable %>%
  select(c("age_display", "attempt_num", "predicted_p")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = attempt_num,
    values_from = predicted_p,
    names_prefix = "cycle_"
  )

attempt_predictions_wide %>%
  write_csv("outputs/attempt_probabilities_by_age_wide.csv")

```

## Binomial Model (Actuarial model)

```{r}
# Account for patient heterogeneity and overdispersion

# First aggregate to patient level
patient_summary <- m1df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # AMH bins
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High"
    ),
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High"))) |> 
  group_by(pat_id, age, age_group, amh_bin, afc) %>%
  summarize(
    attempts = n(),
    successes = as.integer(sum(pregnant)),
    .groups = "drop"
)

print(paste0("Dropping rows from patient_summary table that have NA in any predictor variable; row count drops from ",nrow(patient_summary), " to ",nrow(drop_na(patient_summary))))

patient_summary = patient_summary |> 
  drop_na()

# table(patient_summary$age) |> knitr::kable()

binom_mod = run_binomial_model_with_various_distributions(patient_summary, formula = "cbind(successes, attempts - successes) ~ age + amh_bin + afc") |> 
  suppressMessages()

print("Here is the full model validation output:")

validate_model(binom_mod, data = patient_summary, outcome_var = 'successes')

summary(binom_mod)

# Save model to disk
binom_mod |> readr::write_rds("data/models/clinical_pregnancy_model.rds")

# Convert to dataframe.
mod1_binom_model_summary = coef(summary(binom_mod)) |> 
  as.data.frame()

```

```{r}
pregnancy_sim_results <- patient_summary |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    success_sim = rbinom(1, size = 1, prob = pred_p),
    achieve_pregnancy_sim = success_sim >= 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

  DT::datatable()
```

### Plot of simulated payout
```{r}
payout_amount <- 22000

p1_df <- pregnancy_sim_results %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fail_p = 1 - pred_p,
    pred_payout = pred_fail_p * payout_amount
  ) %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pred_payout = mean(pred_payout, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pred_payout = sd(pred_payout, na.rm = TRUE),
    number_patients = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p1_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = mean_pred_payout)) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1, color = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "#2C7FB8", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Expected Insurance Payout by Age",
    subtitle = "Clinical Pregnancy Model",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Average Predicted Payout ($)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(30, 42), breaks = 30:42) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray20"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Egg Actuarial Model (Beta-binomial / Binomial + Monte-Carlo Simulation) {.tabset}

The following statistics are based on these values:

-   cost per cycle: \$22,014

-   payout amount: \$17,611

-   risk margin: 0.2

-   admin load: 0.1

```{r read_in_egg_dataframe_and_clean_it, include = F}

# I'm unsure if we NEED to read in a new copy of the structured egg table... but if we do, we follow the same cleaning steps as above.
egg_df = readr::read_rds("data/clean_data/cleaned_egg_level_df.rds")

# Zoom in on relevant rows, drop rows with no info for age and attempt.
egg_df = egg_df |> 
  dplyr::select(pat_id, egg_id, age, attempt, pgd_clinresult, frozen_embryo, frozen_egg, afc_other, afc_first_baseline, amh, amh_start) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(age))

# Calculate age_group
egg_df = egg_df |> 
  dplyr::mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age < 35 ~ "<35",
    age >= 35 & age <= 37 ~ "35-37",
    age >= 38 & age <= 40 ~ "38-40",
    age >= 41 ~ "41+"
  )
)

# Add treatment course ID and cycle number ID columns
df = df |> 
  dplyr::arrange(pat_id, treatment_start_date) |>
  dplyr::group_by(pat_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    gap_days = as.numeric(treatment_start_date - dplyr::lag(treatment_start_date)),
    new_treat_course = ifelse(is.na(gap_days) | gap_days > 365, 1, 0),
    treat_course_id = cumsum(new_treat_course)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(gap_days,new_treat_course)) |> 
  # Define cycle number within a treatment course
  dplyr::group_by(pat_id, treat_course_id) |>
  dplyr::arrange(treatment_start_date) |>
  # Cycle number is the key column we're making here - within a given 'treat_course', 
  # we can have various related cycles (cycle 1, 2, etc.)
  dplyr::mutate(cycle_number = dplyr::row_number()) |> 
  dplyr::ungroup()

cost_per_cycle <- 22014
payout_amount <- 17611
risk_margin <- 0.20
admin_load <- 0.10

n_sim <- 5000 # Monte Carlo iterations
```

## Euploid Embryo Model (Binomial) {.tabset}

### Model Outputs

```{r}
############################################################
# 1. EUPLOID EMBRYO MODEL (BINOMIAL)
############################################################

# We'll need to join AFC and AMH from cycle-level table to egg table.

# Aggregate structured egg table to patient-level counts
euploid_summary <- egg_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!frozen_egg) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    success = pgd_clinresult %in% c("Euploid", "Normal") & !is.na(pgd_clinresult)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # AMH bins
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High"
    ),
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High"))) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(pat_id, amh_bin) |>
  dplyr::reframe(
    successes = sum(success),
    number_of_eggs_attempted = dplyr::n(),
    age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_group = dplyr::first(age_group),
    afc = mean(afc_first_baseline,na.rm=T)
  )

print(paste0("Dropping rows from euploid_summary table that have NA in any predictor variable; row count drops from ",nrow(euploid_summary), " to ",nrow(drop_na(euploid_summary))))

euploid_summary = euploid_summary |> 
  drop_na()

# Fit binomial model for per-egg euploid probability as a function of age
euploid_binom_model <- glm(
  cbind(successes, number_of_eggs_attempted - successes) ~ age + afc + amh_bin,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = euploid_summary
)

validate_model(euploid_binom_model, euploid_summary, 'successes')

# Save model to disk
euploid_binom_model |> readr::write_rds("data/models/euploid_model.rds")

# Save coefficient summary
euploid_model_summary <- coef(summary(euploid_binom_model)) |>
  as.data.frame()

# Add predicted probabilities
euploid_summary <- euploid_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pred_p = predict(euploid_binom_model, newdata = euploid_summary, type = "response"),
    prob_ge1_euploid = 1 - (1 - pred_p)^number_of_eggs_attempted
  )

# Simulate outcomes per patient
set.seed(123)

euploid_sim_results <- euploid_summary |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    success_sim = rbinom(1, size = number_of_eggs_attempted, prob = pred_p),
    ge1_euploid_sim = success_sim >= 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# # Plot predicted per-egg probabilities from the model
# euploid_summary |>
#   ggplot(aes(x = pred_p)) +
#   geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
#   labs(
#     x = "Predicted Per-Egg Euploid Probability",
#     title = "Distribution of Predicted Probabilities"
#   ) +
#   theme_minimal()

euploid_sim_results |>
  DT::datatable()
```

### Simulated Probabilities averaged by Age
```{r}
euploid_sim_results |> 
  dplyr::group_by(age) |> 
  dplyr::reframe(
    pct_1_plus_euploid_sim = mean(ge1_euploid_sim, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(age) |> 
  knitr::kable()
```

## Single-cycle Egg Model (Binomial model) {.tabset}

```{r}
# Remove rows where amh is unknown.
df = df |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(amh))
```

### Model Outputs

Note: this model uses the patient / cycle-level table and does not currently filter away rows for eggs of cryo_day_2 or cryo_day_3; N of this dataframe is therefore `r nrow(df)`.

```{r}
threshold_single <- 7

single_cycle_egg_df <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(afc),
    !is.na(amh),
    !is.na(num_eggs_collected),
    !is.na(treatment_start_date)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pat_id, treatment_start_date) %>%
  group_by(pat_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    success = as.numeric(num_eggs_collected >= threshold_single),
    
    # AMH bins
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High"
    ),
    
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High"))
  )

# Model
s_egg_model <- glm(
  success ~ age + afc + amh_bin,
  family = binomial,
  data = single_cycle_egg_df
)

validate_model(s_egg_model, single_cycle_egg_df, "success")

# Save model to disk
s_egg_model |> readr::write_rds("data/models/single_egg_model.rds")

s_egg_model_summary <- coef(summary(s_egg_model)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

coef_s_egg <- coef(s_egg_model)

# Add predicted probabilities
single_cycle_egg_df <- single_cycle_egg_df %>%
  mutate(
    pred_p = predict(s_egg_model, newdata = single_cycle_egg_df, type = "response")
  )

# Simulate outcomes
set.seed(123)

s_egg_sim_results <- single_cycle_egg_df %>%
  mutate(
    success_sim = rbinom(n(), size = 1, prob = pred_p)
  )

s_egg_sim_results %>%
  DT::datatable()
```

## Two-cycle Egg Model (Binomial model) {.tabset}

Note: this model includes only patients that have more than one treatment recorded in the dataset.
Note: this model assumes that treatments that occur within 365 days belong to a single treatment course, i.e. a collection of cycles including cycle 1, cycle 2, etc.; this assumption was necessary to compute this model because the dataset lacks a variable that otherwise links treatments across time. We could modify this assumption by removing this 365-day date proximity threshold, though this may incorrectly imply relatedness between distinct treatments performed by a patient across multiple years.

### Model Outputs

```{r}
threshold_two <- 15

# Keep patients with at least 2 cycles, then summarize first 2 cycles only
df_multiple <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(afc),
    !is.na(amh),
    !is.na(num_eggs_collected),
    !is.na(treatment_start_date)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pat_id, treatment_start_date) %>%
  group_by(pat_id) %>%
  mutate(cycle_order = row_number()) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  filter(cycle_order <= 2) %>%
  summarise(
    total_eggs_first2 = sum(num_eggs_collected, na.rm = TRUE),
    eggs_cycle1 = first(num_eggs_collected),
    age = first(age),
    age_group = first(age_group),
    amh = first(amh),
    afc = first(afc),
    attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    successes = as.numeric(total_eggs_first2 >= threshold_two),
    amh_bin = case_when(
      amh < 0.5 ~ "Very low",
      amh >= 0.5 & amh < 1.0 ~ "Low",
      amh >= 1.0 & amh <= 3.0 ~ "Normal",
      amh > 3.0 ~ "High"
    ),
    amh_bin = factor(amh_bin, levels = c("Very low", "Low", "Normal", "High"))
  )

two_egg_model <- glm(
  successes ~ age + afc + amh_bin + eggs_cycle1,
  family = binomial,
  data = df_multiple
)

validate_model(two_egg_model, df_multiple, "successes")

# Save model to disk
two_egg_model |> readr::write_rds("data/models/two_egg_model.rds")

two_egg_model_summary <- coef(summary(two_egg_model)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Add predicted probabilities
df_multiple <- df_multiple %>%
  mutate(
    pred_p = predict(two_egg_model, newdata = df_multiple, type = "response")
  )

# Simulate outcomes per patient
set.seed(123)

df_multiple_sim_results <- df_multiple %>%
  mutate(
    success_sim = rbinom(n(), size = 1, prob = pred_p)
  )

print("The following table represents predicted successes or failures at the unique pat_id level based on the two-cycle egg binomial model.")

df_multiple_sim_results %>%
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r}
# Pricing Outputs
calc_pricing <- function(expected_payout_vec, model_name) {
  tibble::tibble(
    model = model_name,
    expected_cost = mean(expected_payout_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_95 = quantile(expected_payout_vec, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    premium = expected_cost * (1 + risk_margin + admin_load)
  )
}

# Use the same payout amount consistently
payout_amount <- 22000

# 1. Clinical pregnancy model
pregnancy_costs <- pregnancy_sim_results %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fail_p = 1 - pred_p,
    expected_payout = pred_fail_p * payout_amount
  )

pregnancy_results <- calc_pricing(
  expected_payout_vec = pregnancy_costs$expected_payout,
  model_name = "Clinical Pregnancy"
)

# 2. Euploid embryo model
euploid_costs <- euploid_sim_results %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fail_p = 1 - prob_ge1_euploid,
    expected_payout = pred_fail_p * payout_amount
  )

euploid_results <- calc_pricing(
  expected_payout_vec = euploid_costs$expected_payout,
  model_name = "Euploid Embryo"
)

# 3. Single-cycle egg model
s_egg_costs <- single_cycle_egg_df %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fail_p = 1 - pred_p,
    expected_payout = pred_fail_p * payout_amount
  )

egg_results <- calc_pricing(
  expected_payout_vec = s_egg_costs$expected_payout,
  model_name = "Single-Cycle Egg"
)

# 4. Two-cycle egg model
two_egg_costs <- df_multiple %>%
  mutate(
    pred_fail_p = 1 - pred_p,
    expected_payout = pred_fail_p * payout_amount
  )

two_results <- calc_pricing(
  expected_payout_vec = two_egg_costs$expected_payout,
  model_name = "Two-Cycle Egg"
)
```

## Final Comparison

```{r}
final_results <- bind_rows(
  pregnancy_results,
  euploid_results,
  egg_results,
  two_results
) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_cost = scales::dollar(expected_cost),
    var_95 = scales::dollar(var_95),
    premium = scales::dollar(premium)
  )

knitr::kable(final_results)

############################################################
# END
############################################################
```
